arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَ اللَّيْلَ وَ النَّهَارَ بِقُوَّتِهِ
وَ مَيَّزَ بَيْنَهُمَا بِقُدْرَتِهِ
وَ جَعَلَ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا حَدّاً مَحْدُوداً ، وَ أَمَداً مَمْدُوداً
يُولِجُ كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا فِي صَاحِبِهِ ،
وَ يُولِجُ صَاحِبَهُ فِيهِ
بِتَقْدِيرٍ مِنْهُ لِلْعِبَادِ فِيمَا يَغْذُوهُمْ بِهِ ،
وَ يُنْشِئُهُمْ عَلَيْهِ
فَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ اللَّيْلَ
لِيَسْكُنُوا فِيهِ
مِنْ حَرَكَاتِ التَّعَبِ وَ نَهَضَاتِ النَّصَبِ ،
وَ جَعَلَهُ لِبَاساً لِيَلْبَسُوا مِنْ رَاحَتِهِ وَ مَنَامِهِ ،
فَيَكُونَ ذَلِكَ لَهُمْ جَمَاماً وَ قُوَّةً ،
وَ لِيَنَالُوا بِهِ لَذَّةً وَ شَهْوَةً
وَ خَلَقَ لَهُمُ النَّهَارَ مُبْصِراً
لِيَبْتَغُوا فِيهِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ ،
وَ لِيَتَسَبَّبُوا إِلَى رِزْقِهِ ، وَ يَسْرَحُوا فِي أَرْضِهِ ،
طَلَباً لِمَا فِيهِ نَيْلُ الْعَاجِلِ مِنْ دُنْيَاهُمْ ،
وَ دَرَكُ الْآجِلِ فِي أُخْرَاهُمْ
بِكُلِّ ذَلِكَ يُصْلِحُ شَأْنَهُمْ ،
وَ يَبْلُو أَخْبَارَهُمْ ،
وَ يَنْظُرُ كَيْفَ هُمْ فِي أَوْقَاتِ طَاعَتِهِ ،
وَ مَنَازِلِ فُرُوضِهِ ، وَ مَوَاقِعِ أَحْكَامِهِ ،
لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا ،
وَ يَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى .
اللَّهُمَّ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا فَلَقْتَ لَنَا مِنَ الْإِصْبَاحِ ،
وَ مَتَّعْتَنَا بِهِ مِنْ ضَوْءِ النَّهَارِ ،
وَ بَصَّرْتَنَا مِنْ مَطَالِبِ الْأَقْوَاتِ ،
وَ وَقَيْتَنَا فِيهِ مِنْ طَوَارِقِ الْآفَاتِ .
أَصْبَحْنَا وَ أَصْبَحَتِ الْأَشْيَاءُ كُلُّهَا بِجُمْلَتِهَا لَكَ
سَمَاؤُهَا وَ أَرْضُهَا ،
وَ مَا بَثَثْتَ فِي كُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا ،
سَاكِنُهُ وَ مُتَحَرِّكُهُ ، وَ مُقِيمُهُ وَ شَاخِصُهُ
وَ مَا عَلَا فِي الْهَوَاءِ ، وَ مَا كَنَّ تَحْتَ الثَّرَى
أَصْبَحْنَا فِي قَبْضَتِكَ
يَحْوِينَا مُلْكُكَ وَ سُلْطَانُكَ ،
وَ تَضُمُّنَا مَشِيَّتُكَ ،
وَ نَتَصَرَّفُ عَنْ أَمْرِكَ ،
وَ نَتَقَلَّبُ فِي تَدْبِيرِكَ.
لَيْسَ لَنَا مِنَ الْأَمْرِ إِلَّا مَا قَضَيْتَ ،
وَ لَا مِنَ الْخَيْرِ إِلَّا مَا أَعْطَيْتَ .
وَ هَذَا يَوْمٌ حَادِثٌ جَدِيدٌ ،
وَ هُوَ عَلَيْنَا شَاهِدٌ عَتِيدٌ ،
إِنْ أَحْسَنَّا وَدَّعَنَا بِحَمْدٍ ،
وَ إِنْ أَسَأْنَا فَارَقَنَا بِذَمٍّ .
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ،
وَ ارْزُقْنَا حُسْنَ مُصَاحَبَتِهِ ،
وَ اعْصِمْنَا مِنْ سُوءِ مُفَارَقَتِهِ بِارْتِكَابِ جَرِيرَةٍ ،
أَوِ اقْتِرَافِ صَغِيرَةٍ أَوْ كَبِيرَةٍ
وَ أَجْزِلْ لَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ ،
وَ أَخْلِنَا فِيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ ،
وَ امْلَأْ لَنَا مَا بَيْنَ طَرَفَيْهِ حَمْداً وَ شُكْراً
وَ أَجْراً وَ ذُخْراً وَ فَضْلًا وَ إِحْسَاناً .
اللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ عَلَى الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ مَئُونَتَنَا ،
وَ امْلَأْ لَنَا مِنْ حَسَنَاتِنَا صَحَائِفَنَا ،
وَ لَا تُخْزِنَا عِنْدَهُمْ بِسُوءِ أَعْمَالِنَا .
اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي كُلِّ سَاعَةٍ مِنْ سَاعَاتِهِ
حَظّاً مِنْ عِبَادِكَ ،
وَ نَصِيباً مِنْ شُكْرِكَ وَ شَاهِدَ صِدْقٍ مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِكَ .
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ،
وَ احْفَظْنَا مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِينَا وَ مِنْ خَلْفِنَا
وَ عَنْ أَيْمَانِنَا وَ عَنْ شَمَائِلِنَا
وَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ نَوَاحِينَا ،
حِفْظاً عَاصِماً مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ ،
هَادِياً إِلَى طَاعَتِكَ ، مُسْتَعْمِلًا لِمَحَبَّتِكَ .
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ،
وَ وَفِّقْنَا فِي يَوْمِنَا هَذَا وَ لَيْلَتِنَا هَذِهِ وَ فِي جَمِيعِ أَيَّامِنَا
لِاسْتِعْمَالِ الْخَيْرِ ،
وَ هِجْرَانِ الشَّرِّ ، وَ شُكْرِ النِّعَمِ ،
وَ اتِّبَاعِ السُّنَنِ ، وَ مُجَانَبَةِ الْبِدَعِ ،
وَ الْأَمْرِ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ ، وَ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ ،
وَ حِيَاطَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ ،
وَ انْتِقَاصِ الْبَاطِلِ وَ إِذْلَالِهِ ،
وَ نُصْرَةِ الْحَقِّ وَ إِعْزَازِهِ ، وَ إِرْشَادِ الضَّالِّ ،
وَ مُعَاوَنَةِ الضَّعِيفِ ، وَ إِدْرَاكِ اللَّهِيفِ .
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ،
وَ اجْعَلْهُ أَيْمَنَ يَوْمٍ عَهِدْنَاهُ ،
وَ أَفْضَلَ صَاحِبٍ صَحِبْنَاهُ ،
وَ خَيْرَ وَقْتٍ ظَلِلْنَا فِيهِ
وَ اجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَرْضَى مَنْ مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَ النَّهَارُ مِنْ جُمْلَةِ خَلْقِكَ ،
أَشْكَرَهُمْ لِمَا أَوْلَيْتَ مِنْ نِعَمِكَ ،
وَ أَقْوَمَهُمْ بِمَا شَرَعْتَ مِنْ شرَائِعِكَ ،
وَ أَوْقَفَهُمْ عَمَّا حَذَّرْتَ مِنْ نَهْيِكَ .
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُشْهِدُكَ
وَ كَفَى بِكَ شَهِيداً ،
وَ أُشْهِدُ سَمَاءَكَ وَ أَرْضَكَ وَ مَنْ أَسْكَنْتَهُمَا مِنْ مَلائِكَتِكَ وَ سَائِرِ خَلْقِكَ
فِي يَوْمِي هَذَا وَ سَاعَتِي هَذِهِ وَ لَيْلَتِي هَذِهِ وَ مُسْتَقَرِّي هَذَا ،
أَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ ،
قَائِمٌ بِالْقِسْطِ ، عَدْلٌ فِي الْحُكْمِ ،
رَءُوفٌ بِالْعِبَادِ ، مَالِكُ الْمُلْكِ ،
رَحِيمٌ بِالْخَلْقِ .
وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَ رَسُولُكَ
و خِيَرَتُكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ ،
حَمَّلْتَهُ رِسَالَتَكَ فَأَدَّاهَا ،
وَ أَمَرْتَهُ بِالنُّصْحِ لِأُمَّتِهِ فَنَصَحَ لَهَا .
اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ،
أَكْثَرَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ ،
وَ آتِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا آتَيْتَ أَحَداً مِنْ عِبَادِكَ ،
وَ اجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ وَ أَكْرَمَ
مَا جَزَيْتَ أَحَداً مِنْ أَنْبِيَائِكَ عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ
إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بِالْجَسِيمِ ،
الْغَافِرُ لِلْعَظِيمِ ،
وَ أَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ مِنْ كُلِّ رَحِيمٍ ،
فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ الْأَخْيَارِ الْأَنْجَبِينَ .
transliteration: Wa ja‘ala likulli wāḥidin minhumā ḥaddan maḥdūdā, wa amadan mamdūdā
Yūliju kulla wāḥidin minhumā fī ṣāḥibih,
Bi-taqdīrin minhu lil-‘ibādi fīmā yaghdhūhum bih,
wa ja‘alahu libāsan liyalbasū min rāḥatihi wa manāmih,
fa-yakūna dhālika lahum jamāman wa quwwah,
wa liyanālū bihi ladhdhatan wa shahwah
wa liyatasabbabū ilā rizqih, wa yasraḥū fī arḍih,
ṭalaban limā fīhi naylu-l-‘ājili min dunyāhum,
wa yanẓuru kayfa hum fī awqāti ṭā‘atih,
wa manāzili furūḍih, wa mawāqi‘i aḥkāmih,
Allāhumma fa-laka-l-ḥamdu ‘alā mā falaqta lanā mina-l-iṣbāḥ,
Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥati-l-ashyā’u kulluhā bi-jumlatihā lak
wa mā bathathta fī kulli wāḥidin minhumā,
sākinuhu wa mutaḥarrikuh, wa muqīmuhu wa shākhiṣuh
wa mā ‘alā fi-l-hawā’, wa mā kanna taḥta-th-tharā
Laysa lanā mina-l-amri illā mā qaḍayt,
wa lā mina-l-khayri illā mā a‘ṭayt.
wa-‘ṣimnā min sū’i mufāraqatihi bi-rtikābi jarīrah,
wa-mla’ lanā mā bayna ṭarafayhi ḥamdan wa shukrā
wa ajran wa dhukhran wa faḍlan wa iḥsānā.
Allāhumma-j‘al lanā fī kulli sā‘atin min sā‘ātih
wa naṣīban min shukrik wa shāhida ṣidqin min malā’ikatik.
wa-ḥfaẓnā min bayni aydīnā wa min khalfina
wa waffiqnā fī yawminā hādhā wa laylatinā hādhih wa fī jamī‘i ayyāminā
wa nuṣrati-l-ḥaqqi wa i‘zāzih, wa irshādi-ḍ-ḍāll,
Wa-j‘alnā min arḍā man marra ‘alayhi-l-laylu wa-n-nahāru min jumlati khalqik,
wa aqwamahum bimā shara‘ta min sharā’i‘ik,
wa ushhidu samā’aka wa arḍaka wa man askantahumā min malā’ikatika wa sā’iri khalqik
fī yawmī hādhā wa sā‘atī hādhih wa laylatī hādhih wa mustaqarrī hādhā,
annī ashhadu annaka anta-llāhu-lladhī lā ilāha illā ant,
wa amartahu bi-n-nuṣḥi li-ummatihi fa-naṣaḥa lahā.
akthara mā ṣallayta ‘alā aḥadin min khalqik,
wa ātihi ‘annā afḍala mā ātayta aḥadan min ‘ibādik,
mā jazayta aḥadan min anbiyā’ika ‘an ummatih
wa anta Arḥamu min kulli raḥīm,
translation: Praise belongs to God who created the night and the day by His strength,
and distinguished between them by His power,
and appointed for each of them a determined limit and an extended term.
He makes each of them enter into the other,
and He makes its companion enter into it
by a measure from Him for the servants in that with which He nourishes them,
and upon which He raises them.
So He created for them the night
that they might rest in it
from wearisome movements and the stirrings of toil,
and He made it a garment, that they might be clothed in its repose and its sleep,
so that it may be for them a refreshment and a strength,
and that they might attain thereby pleasure and desire.
And He created for them the day, full of light,
that they might seek therein of His bounty,
and find means to His provision, and roam freely in His earth,
seeking that in which is the attainment of the immediate from their world,
and the reaching of the deferred in their hereafter.
By all of that He sets right their affair,
and tests their states,
and observes how they are in the times of His obedience,
and the stations of His obligations, and the places of His ordinances,
'to repay those who did evil with what they wrought,
and repay those who did good with goodness.'
O God, so to You belongs praise for what You have split open for us of the dawn,
and let us enjoy thereof the light of day,
and made us see the ways to seek sustenance,
and protected us therein from the visitations of calamities.
We have entered the morning, and all things in their entirety have entered the morning belonging to You:
its heaven and its earth,
and what You have scattered in each of them,
its still and its moving, its resident and its traveller,
and what is high in the air, and what is hidden beneath the soil.
We have entered the morning in Your grasp;
Your kingdom and Your sovereignty contain us,
and Your will encompasses us.
We act according to Your command,
and we alternate in Your governance.
We have nothing of the affair except what You have decreed,
and nothing of good except what You have given.
And this is a new, fresh day,
and it is over us a ready witness.
If we do good, it will bid us farewell with praise,
and if we do evil, it will part from us with blame.
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
and grant us its good companionship,
and preserve us from its evil parting through committing a sin,
or perpetrating a minor or major offense.
And make abundant for us therein the good deeds,
and keep us free therein from evil deeds,
and fill for us what is between its two ends with praise and gratitude,
and reward and treasure and bounty and beneficence.
O God, make light for the noble scribes our burden,
and fill for us from our good deeds our scrolls,
and do not disgrace us before them with our evil actions.
O God, appoint for us in every hour of its hours
a share from Your servants,
and a portion of Your gratitude, and a truthful witness from Your angels.
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
and protect us from before us and from behind us,
and from our right sides and from our left sides,
and from all our directions,
a protection preventing disobedience to You,
guiding to Your obedience, employing for Your love.
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
and grant us success in this our day, and this our night, and in all our days
to employ good,
and abandon evil, and give thanks for blessings,
and follow the Sunnahs, and avoid innovations,
and enjoin what is right, and forbid what is wrong,
and guard Islam,
and diminish falsehood and humiliate it,
and support truth and exalt it, and guide the misguided,
and help the weak, and aid the distressed.
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
and make it the most blessed day we have known,
and the best companion we have accompanied,
and the best time in which we have lingered.
And make us among the most pleasing of Your creation upon whom night and day have passed,
the most grateful of them for the blessings You have bestowed,
the most upright of them in what You have legislated of Your laws,
and the most observant of them regarding what You have warned against in Your prohibitions.
O God, I call You to witness,
and You suffice as a witness,
and I call to witness Your heaven and Your earth, and those whom You have made dwell in them of Your angels and the rest of Your creation,
in this my day, and this my hour, and this my night, and this my place of stay,
that I bear witness that You are God, there is no god but You,
Upholding justice, Just in judgment,
Clement to the servants, Master of the kingdom,
Merciful to the creation.
And that Muhammad is Your servant and Your messenger,
and Your chosen one from Your creation.
You charged him with Your message, and he delivered it,
and You commanded him to give sincere counsel to his community, and he counseled it.
O God, so bless Muhammad and his Household,
more than You have blessed any one of Your creation,
and give him on our behalf the best You have given any one of Your servants,
and reward him on our behalf the best and most generous reward
with which You have rewarded any of Your prophets for his community.
Indeed, You are the Bestower of immensities,
the Forgiver of great [sins],
and You are more merciful than any merciful one.
So bless Muhammad and his Household,
the good, the pure, the chosen, the noble.
